citations.description: Ticket comment: 'Next: await Verified on 1238, submit chain in order, close PRs #123/#124 on GitHub' — Verified run not yet confirmed complete at time of comment.

findings.criterion: AC0 (P0): a Gerrit change bumping click to >=8.3.3 in uv.lock is merged FIRST; its CI run's pip-audit step passes (PYSEC-2026-2132 cleared), unblocking all other changes.
findings.detail: The click override is present in pyproject.toml and uv.lock (codebase evidence that the change landed), but the criterion also requires the CI pip-audit step to have passed in the Gerrit Verified run — a CI run result that is not verifiable from the codebase. The ticket comment says 'Next: await Verified on 1238, submit chain in order', indicating the Verified run had not yet completed at the time of the last status update. The 'merged FIRST' ordering guarantee is also not codebase-verifiable.
findings.remediation: Record a ticket comment confirming Change 1238 was submitted in Gerrit with Verified +1 (naming the CI run URL/ID and confirming pip-audit showed no known vulnerabilities).

citations.description: Ticket comment: 'Change A = 1244: PR #123 verbatim (setup-python v7 + pypi-publish re-pin, 13 workflows)' — pushed but not confirmed submitted/merged with votes.

findings.criterion: AC1: A Gerrit change with PR #123's diff (13 workflows + allowlist echo lines, byte-identical to `gh pr diff 123`) is merged with `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`; the Verified run executed `actions/setup-python@v7` successfully.
findings.detail: The workflow files in the repo show setup-python@v7 (codebase evidence the change landed), but the criterion requires the specific votes (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1) and confirmation that the Verified run executed setup-python@v7 successfully — these are Gerrit/CI facts not verifiable from the codebase. Additionally, the allowlist echo line in release.yml line 115 still says '# v6.3.0' in the comment while using the v7 SHA (5fda3b95...), which may indicate the echo allowlist was not updated byte-identically to the PR diff. The ticket comment says Change A = 1244 was pushed but does not confirm submission.
findings.remediation: Record a ticket comment confirming Change 1244 was submitted in Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 (naming the Gerrit change URL and the CI run that exercised setup-python@v7).

citations.description: Ticket comment (most recent status): 'Next: await Verified on 1238, submit chain in order, close PRs #123/#124 on GitHub' — PR closure explicitly listed as pending future action.

findings.criterion: AC3: Both PRs #123 and #124 are closed on GitHub with a comment naming the Gerrit change(s) that landed the content.
findings.detail: The ticket comment explicitly states 'Next: await Verified on 1238, submit chain in order, close PRs #123/#124 on GitHub' — the PR closure is listed as future work not yet done. GitHub PR state is external to the codebase and cannot be verified from the repository. No attestation in the ticket confirms the PRs were closed.
findings.remediation: Close PRs #123 and #124 on GitHub with comments naming the Gerrit changes (e.g. 'landed as Gerrit change 1244; GitHub is a read-only mirror'), then record a ticket comment with the PR URLs and closure timestamps.
